question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Exaltation
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ecstasy**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exaltation **means an excessively intensified sense of well-being, power, or importance. (उमंग; उत्कर्ष)
 
• Marked option **Ecstasy **means an overwhelming feeling of great happiness or joyful excitement. (परम आनंद; उत्साह)
 
• It is clear that '**Exaltation**' and '**Ecstasy**' are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Dejection**: A sad and depressed state; low spirits. (उदासी )
 
• **Satisfaction**: The act of fulfilling a need, desire, or appetite. (संतोष)
 
• **Elaboration**: The process of developing or presenting a theory, policy, or system in further detail. (विशदीकरण; विस्तार)
